records.processing_note: Sample one frame every 2 seconds from t=0; resize longest edge to <=640 px; JPEG quality 90; preserve clip ID, source frame index, timestamp, dimensions, and clip-level label.
records.source_version: Boreal Forest Fire Dataset, Subset B; released 2025-02-28
records.known_limitation: Clip-level binary labels have no event intervals; sparse frames cannot establish event timing or detector performance.
